name: RETA Benchmark
description: A benchmark for analysis of retinal vascular trees, providing annotated retinal images and tasks to evaluate segmentation and vascular analysis algorithms.
evaluation_method: Segmentation metrics such as Dice / F1, sensitivity/specificity and vessel-width/centerline error for structural analysis
typical_sota_score: 80–95% (Dice/F1 depending on exact task and test split)
reputation: A recognized dataset/benchmark within retinal vessel segmentation and vascular analysis research with moderate community use for method comparison.
notes: Non-LLM medical imaging benchmark; annotation subjectivity and dataset size/diversity can limit generalization; evaluation depends on exact labeling protocol (centerline vs. full-width segmentation).
